name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Somfy Rts
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends a Somfy RTS command, as used by Somfy blinds, shutters and awnings on 433.42 MHz, to a remote transmitter. ESPHome acts as one more remote: it has its own address and a rolling code that must grow by one with every command, so keep the code in a [global](https://esphome.io/components/globals/) with `restore_value: true` and increment it in the lambda. Pair the device by holding the program button on an existing remote until the motor jogs, then sending `control: 0x8` from ESPHome. Real remotes send each frame several times, so use `repeat`.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The 24-bit address ESPHome uses as a remote. Pick any value and keep it.

config_entries.label: Control
config_entries.description: The 4-bit command: `0x1` My (stop), `0x2` Up, `0x4` Down, `0x8` Prog. Combinations such as `0x3` (My and Up) are sent as given.

config_entries.label: Key
config_entries.description: The 8-bit encryption key byte; `0xA0` works for most receivers.

config_entries.label: Rolling Code
config_entries.description: The 16-bit rolling code. Each command must use a higher code than the one before, or the receiver ignores it.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Control In Key
config_entries.description: Some remotes put the command in the low nibble of the key byte instead of the control nibble. Set this if the device does not react; the low nibble of `key` must then be `0`. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
